box: Box A -- love-match (/game/love-match/) flow: pick person 1 -> pick person 2 -> reveal -> result, walked end to end in a real browser (mount() had never executed in any engine before this run)
method: scripts/driver.mjs, one CDP tab, real headless Chrome (--headless --disable-gpu --no-sandbox --remote-debugging-port=9222), against a real build (npm run build + npx serve dist/ -l 4321). Navigated to http://localhost:4321/game/love-match/, wiped storage on-origin (nav to localhost FIRST, never about:blank) and verified localStorage.length === 0 / sessionStorage.length === 0 immediately after the wipe. Roster was seeded via the NAMED-ENTRY path, not #start-numbered: typed 'ก้อง' into #roster-add-name (dispatching a real 'input' event) and clicked #roster-add-btn, then repeated for 'ฟ้า' -- both auto-select (PlayerSetup.astro's addBtn handler calls selected.add(name)), confirmed via #roster-list checkbox state (checkedCount: 2) before clicking #start-round. #start-round's listener in src/pages/game/[id].astro is async (awaits a dynamic import before game.mount()), so a 400ms settle was inserted after the click before reading DOM state -- an earlier attempt without this wait read the stage as empty and looked like a failure that was actually a race, not a bug. Calibrated the discriminating detector pair BEFORE and AFTER each transition (trap 2): #lm-reset absent pre-pick / present after picking person 1; #lm-again absent on the pick screen / present on the result screen. Picked by exact chip textContent (not chip index -- the picked person's chip is removed from the DOM on the second screen, per renderPick's `if (index === first) return`). Score/line/pair paragraphs were discriminated by their distinct inline-style substrings ('16vw' = score, '5.5vw' = line, '1.25rem' = pair) since love-match.ts's LINE_STYLE and PAIR_STYLE both also contain 'overflow-wrap:anywhere', making that alone ambiguous.
